fields.label: Enable FHIR Sync
fields.description: When enabled, clinical records are pushed to the FHIR server on save and pulls are allowed.

fields.label: FHIR Server URL
fields.description: Base URL of the FHIR R4 server, e.g. http://hapi:8091/fhir

fields.label: Auth Token (Bearer)
fields.description: Optional Bearer token sent in the Authorization header. Leave blank for unauthenticated servers.

fields.label: Last Pull At
fields.description: Automatically stamped after each successful pull run.

fields.label: Enable AI Case Summaries
fields.description: When enabled, AI-powered clinical summaries are generated for each Case when new observations are recorded.

fields.label: AI Provider
fields.description: Select the AI provider. Default uses the bundled Ollama container. Switch to Claude or OpenAI for managed API access.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Anthropic API key (Claude), OpenAI API key, or leave blank for unauthenticated local models.

fields.label: Base URL (Local provider)
fields.description: Bundled Ollama service: http://ollama:11434/v1. Override for LM Studio or external endpoints.

fields.label: Model Name
fields.description: Bundled default: llama3.1:8b. For Claude: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. For OpenAI: gpt-4o-mini.

fields.label: Minimum App Version
fields.description: System-wide minimum mobile app version, e.g. 1.4.0. Fallback when a user has no override in User App Control.

fields.label: Latest App Version
fields.description: Latest available mobile app version, e.g. 1.6.2. No per-user override exists for this value.

fields.label: Default Language
fields.description: System-level default language code (matches Flutter client locales en/bn). Fallback when no per-user override.

fields.label: AI Feature Enabled (Default)
fields.description: System-level default for mobile AI feature. Fallback when no per-user override.
